entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return a helmet I bought. This is ridiculous, I've been on hold for ten minutes.
I apologize for the wait time. I can certainly help you with a return. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?
It's VF-8675309. I want a full refund, and I want it now. Don't try to give me store credit.
Thank you for that. I've pulled up your order. Just to make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

What does it matter? The color is completely wrong! It looked charcoal on your website, but it's practically jet black. I'm not wearing it. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the thing.
I understand your frustration when an item's color doesn't meet your expectations. I just need to confirm the reason for our records.

The record is that I'm an unhappy customer! If you can't process this refund, get me your manager. I will leave a review on every single website about this. A helmet is a critical piece of safety equipment; the least you can do is get the color right!
That won't be necessary, I can definitely resolve this for you. Please just give me one moment to review the return eligibility for your order.
Unbelievable. Fine. But you're wasting my time.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've confirmed everything. I see the helmet was delivered 15 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on standard items within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. I can approve this return for a full refund right now.
Oh. So you're actually going to do it? No more questions?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a confirmation email to you now which will include a prepaid shipping label. Please attach that to the original shipping box and drop it off at your local post office.
And I'll get a full refund?
Yes. Once our warehouse receives the helmet and confirms the box is unopened, a full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Okay. Good. That's all I wanted in the first place.
I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
